package.name: sig_proc_cpp
package.description:
C++ signal processing node.
Subscribes to /sensor/encoder (StampedInt64) and /sensor/accel (StampedFloat64). Applies siglib filters directly (no Python, no pybind11). Publishes filtered outputs on /filtered/encoder and /filtered/accel.
Uses header.stamp for dt computation — never arrival time. Dropout policy: dt-extended (alpha recomputed per sample, no special case needed). QoS: reliable + keep_last(100).
